int ev_send_append (  char **  mp,
int *  lp,
char *  dp
) 
 

append string to that in send-buffer.

each string thus appended will have a 3-byte header (1 byte type ('s'), 2 bytes length (network order)).

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
mp the send buffer (address may change due to realloc())
lp current number of bytes in send-buffer (will be updated)
dp data to append
